title: please show all the repeated tasks
body:
Hello developers of Reminder! 
Thanks to the simple and friendly interface, I can manage most of my tasks successfully. However, when I set some repeated tasks on the schedule in one month, there is only the first one displayed, the second would not be shown until the first one completed. This is very hard for me to manage my schedule effectively because I can't remember all the repeated tasks in one month. Therefore, I hope in the near future all my tasks can be shown (shown in the  calendar would be better)  regardess how many times the tasks are repeated. Thanks!
